kpis.statusNote: Status compares the year so far with the target for shares and scores, and for KPIs whose target is for the year; counts judged month by month or quarter by quarter (complaints) use the latest one that is over. With a quarter chosen, it is that quarter's figure, a yearly total's target shared out over the four. The line under each month shows how that month stands on its own. Green is on target; amber is short of it but past the baseline; red is at or behind the baseline. Figures in italics are worked out from the tickets; a figure entered stands in their place. A dot marks a note.

floorPlan.title: Floor plan
floorPlan.intro: Each wall point on the office plan, with the patch panel port it is wired to and the switch port it is patched to.
floorPlan.emptyHint: Upload the office plan as a PDF. The P and S labels on it (P5-18 over S4-42) are read into outlets you can search and trace.
floorPlan.searchHint: A label (P5-18, S4-42, or S4 for a whole switch), a room or a device.
floorPlan.found: {count, plural, =0 {No outlet matches} one {# outlet matches} other {# outlets match}}
floorPlan.deleteDetail: Its {count, plural, one {# outlet goes} other {# outlets go}} with it.
floorPlan.mapHint: Drag to move round the plan; Ctrl and the mouse wheel zoom.
floorPlan.placeHint: Click the plan where the outlet is.
floorPlan.moveHint: Click the plan where {label} should be.
floorPlan.notLinked: Which device is this switch? Set it in Plan and switches.
floorPlan.toCheckCount: {count, plural, one {# outlet to check} other {# outlets to check}}
floorPlan.allGood: Nothing to check: every outlet has both labels and its own ports.

problems.duplicatePanelPort: Its patch panel port is on another outlet too.
problems.duplicateSwitchPort: Its switch port is on another outlet too.
problems.written: The drawing has it as “{written}”, tidied to be read.

uploadDialog.title: Upload floor plan
uploadDialog.intro: A PDF of the plan (its first page) or an SVG exported from the drawing. The P and S labels on it are read here, in your browser, before anything is saved; an SVG is shown in 3D.
uploadDialog.name: Name
uploadDialog.found: {count, plural, =0 {No P or S labels were found on it.} one {# outlet found on it.} other {# outlets found on it.}}
uploadDialog.noLabels: Saved without outlets, it can still be used, with outlets added by hand.
uploadDialog.pages: Only its first page is used: it has {count} pages.
uploadDialog.checkCount: {count, plural, one {# to check after saving:} other {# to check after saving:}}
uploadDialog.readNew: Read them from the new drawing ({count, plural, one {# outlet} other {# outlets}}, in place of the {current} now on the plan)
uploadDialog.keep: Keep the outlets as they are, moved onto the new drawing

errors.fileType: That file is not a PDF.
errors.fileSize: The file is too large (10 MB at most).
errors.unreadable: The PDF could not be read.
errors.generic: The plan could not be saved. Try again.

uploadDialog.fitMatched: {count} outlets line up with the new drawing: they move onto it with what was entered for them.
uploadDialog.fitPoor: Only a rough match ({count} outlets): check their places after saving.
uploadDialog.fitNone: Too few outlets are labelled alike to place them on the new drawing: they stay where they are on the sheet.
uploadDialog.carried: {count, plural, =0 {} one {The room, device and note entered for # outlet go with its label.} other {The rooms, devices and notes entered for # outlets go with their labels.}}

settingsDialog.layersHint: How each layer shows in 3D: raised as walls, as glass, or flat on the floor.
